**Subject: Proposed six-week invoice handling pilot — approval requested**

Hi Morgan,

Thank you for the discussion on invoice handling. I'd like to propose a focused six-week pilot to assess how your current process performs and where time can be recovered.

**Scope:** A six-week assessment of invoice handling. Production rollout is not included.

**Fee:** $30,000 fixed — no variable costs or overruns.

**Target:** You've indicated a hope for 20% shorter handling time. I want to be straightforward: no baseline or measured savings exists today, so the pilot's first job is to establish that baseline. Any improvement figure will be measured, not assumed.

**Why now:** A fixed-fee, time-boxed pilot gives you evidence before any larger commitment. If the results don't justify going further, you've spent a defined amount and gained a documented baseline you don't currently have.

**Conditions:** Security approval is required before we access client data. No start date has been approved yet.

**Decision requested:** Please confirm approval of the pilot scope and the $30,000 fee, subject to security clearance. Once confirmed, I'll work with your team on security sign-off and propose start dates.

Happy to walk through any of this.

Best regards,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
